headline: Gold edges up ₹124 today, silver flat at ₹1,75,000/kg
summary: Today's change in 24k gold is a small rise of ₹124 per gram (about 0.98%) from yesterday, while silver is unchanged at ₹1,75,000 per kg. Over the last 7 days gold has fallen about 6% and silver about 8%, and over the 30 days in our history gold is down about 10% and silver about 20%, with silver's high of ₹2,20,000/kg on 26 October and its low of ₹1,75,000/kg on 20 November. Likely drivers include movements in the US dollar and the rupee, and international gold and silver prices, which are ex-duty and not reflected directly in today's rates.
outlook: Prices have fallen sharply over the past month, but a single day's rise does not signal a trend, so compare rates with your jeweller before buying and factor in making charges and GST.
